text: オーキド　はかせを　しってるね？

structure.jp: オーキド　はかせを

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている. With しる it gives the lasting state of knowing, not the moment of finding out. しってる = 'know'.

patterns.name: 〜ね
patterns.explanation: ね at the end asks the listener to agree. しってるね = 'you know, right?'
